verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a first-party organization plugin for managing organization members, teams, roles and permissions. The homepage claims "Multi-tenancy built in. Teams, roles, invitations, and access control," and a hands-on community report says organizations and multi-tenancy worked through included plugins without special code. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the invitation flow (send/accept/expire mechanics) beyond a homepage tagline, and independent corroboration that invitations specifically work.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model multi-tenant B2B apps with organizations, memberships, and invitation flows out of the box

citations.quote: The organization plugin allows you to manage your organization's members and teams.
Multi-tenancy built in. Teams, roles, invitations, and access control.
organizations, multi-tenant capabilities, various sign-in options - haven't written special code, all handled by Better Auth's included plugins and defaults.
